heroHeadline: September 11, 2001: Al-Qaeda Attacks the United States
heroSubtitle: Four hijacked aircraft killed 2,977 people across New York, Virginia, and Pennsylvania. The deadliest terrorist attack in history sparked two decades of war and transformed global security. Over 9,000 first responders have since died from 9/11-related illnesses — nearly three times the original death toll — and the 9/11 Memorial has announced a permanent 7th moment of silence to honor them.
footerNote: Data sourced from 9/11 Commission Report, NIST investigations, FBI/CIA declassified documents, Congressional records, DoD, FDNY, NYPD, NYC OCME, NIOSH WTC Health Program, September 11th VCF, and major news outlets.
